articles.detail: 5 cycles, all 5 completed and deployed in-cycle, avg 10.4/cycle

experiment: Skipped. No experiment is active, no pause gate is set, and every goal metric cleared its target. The one lever today's logs point at — the feed's multi-source cluster supply — sits in fetch-news-api.js event discovery, and the obvious move there (lowering minArticlesInEvent from 10) is the inverse of the 2026-03-24 experiment that raised it to suppress duplicates; with duplicates at zero for a second straight day that is not a trade worth opening on a day when nothing is failing.
weakestArea: Science is the thinnest goal metric: 7 filings against a floor of 5, down from 12 yesterday, pulling sci-tech from 39% to 33%. It is also the shallowest-sourced — only Nature, Phys.org and Carbon Brief are specialist outlets, with the remaining science slots filled by Al Jazeera, BBC, the Daily Maverick and The Diplomat covering research incidentally. The same pattern was flagged yesterday, so this is now a two-day trend rather than a light-feed day: science clears its floor on volume while the outlets behind it narrow.
watching: Two separate filings treat the Oman-brokered Hormuz arrangement — one reporting the deal as near, one reporting that the claim itself moved oil — while Gulf shipping traffic is measured as steady; the corridor is now a claims-versus-observation story.

The 12 August eclipse has been rejected by the selector in three consecutive cycles as a travel feature while two eclipse articles remain filed ahead of date; check at publication that those two do not restate each other.

AI supply politics split three ways in one day — Xi's open-stack pitch, cheap Chinese models unsettling US valuations, and Microsoft rationing its own capacity — which is one story reaching readers through three desks.
Nigeria's coup cash trail and the trafficking-ring bust both run through the same security apparatus and may consolidate into one thread.
Russia-Ukraine strikes moved toward deep-rear and civilian-adjacent targets (Chekhov and Moscow-area drones, a Kherson vendor, a Crimea barracks shooting) rather than the front.
coverageGaps: Oceania produced nothing today after 2 filings yesterday; it is the only region that regularly drops out of the daily set entirely.
Latin America reached readers through the Fuego eruption alone — a hazard story, with no political or economic reporting from the region.
Unique sources fell from 65 to 48 day-over-day, concentrating output on a narrower outlet set even though no single source came near the 20% share cap.

The multi-source funnel opened light: the 04:00 selector found four usable clusters against a historical median of nine and met neither the politics nor the economy floor, and the 12:03 and 17:01 cycles filled economy entirely from single-source niche picks.
context: A quieter but fully clean day — 52 articles against 69 yesterday, with all five cycles completing and deploying in-cycle, no build failures and no writer turn caps, which is the reliability yesterday's audit was worried about. Timing was steady at 1087s (selector 375s, writer 247s, editor 77s). The multi-source cluster supply the last two audits flagged as an upstream constraint recovered through the day — 9, 11, 11, 13, 13 clusters across the five cycles — and the 22:02 selector met every floor including both multi-source floors, so the shortfall is looking like a morning-feed characteristic rather than a sustained regression. No experiment has been active since 2026-05-26; the queued numerical-density candidate stays queued because scripts/write-prompt.md is out of scope for daily tuning.
